data.content_ref: inline:Artifact 0ba8f16f5116 integrates SRC_011's timing-snapshot mechanism with SRC_009's positional-increment misframing: the 'third' answer arises when positions are recorded by instantaneous snapshots (SRC_011) and the overtaken runner's label is treated as a floor rather than a vacated slot (SRC_009), so the overtaker is credited with third while the overtaken retains second by timing-chip precedence. The integration is a composite mechanism producing 'third' from the interaction of two independent misframings. It is refuted if standard ordinal exchange applies (overtaking immediately transfers rank), or if real-time position tracking updates rank at the moment of passing.
